correctness.rationale: Exact first integral and globally monotone q-coordinate are proved, including all energy ovals. L’Hôpital yields q~g/(kappa x-a) and V~g²/(2kappa) at both signed infinities. Therefore W(q)~q² log|q|, W’(q)~2q log|q|, with uniform compact scaled force Lipschitz bounds from exact W’’=1+x(kappa x-a). Continuous dependence then rigorously gives canonical cosine and scaled period 2pi; inverse-tail and dominated convergence establish physical square-wave and occupation. All quantifiers fixed a,kappa, E→infty, finite p; no uniform x-limit at jumps. The standalone finite checker supports identities and quadrature without replacing proof.
